criteria.description: Identifies the priority leak weighted by volume and fixability (e.g. the large product-view→add-to-cart drop vs. later steps), not merely the single worst percentage.
Quantifies the prize of a realistic improvement in users/revenue (using the $60 AOV), rather than just naming a weak step.
Recommends segmenting the drop-off (device, channel, new vs returning, etc.) rather than relying on the aggregate funnel.
Offers hypotheses for the priority leak and cheap ways to validate them, rather than asserting causes.
Gives a clear where-to-focus-first recommendation and a next diagnostic step.
